item.title: [Due in 5 days] Windows 11 23H2 Enterprise and Education: Microsoft's 30-day reminder names 10 November 2026 as the end of updates
item.description:
The date this page carried for the 23H2 end of updates was read against the November update day; Microsoft has now written 10 November 2026 into the post itself, so the deadline row no longer rests on an inference.

Windows · deadline 2026-11-10 · Count the devices still on Windows 11 23H2 Enterprise and Education and move them to a supported version before the November update; a device left on 23H2 after 10 November stops receiving security fixes.

item.title: [Due in 5 days] Windows 11 23H2 Enterprise and Education reach end of updates in November — 60 days out
item.description:
23H2 is the fallback build most estates parked on while they qualified 24H2 — and 24H2 dies a month earlier.

Windows · deadline 2026-11-10 · Plan one upgrade, not two: any device on 23H2 or 24H2 needs to be on 25H2 or 26H1 before the November update.

item.title: [New] Message Center now carries the eMudhra response: keep certificate trust updates flowing, update disconnected Windows devices and Azure VMs, replace certificates that chain to the removed roots
item.description:
Disconnected devices and VMs that never receive the trust-list update keep trusting certificates an attacker could mint from the recovered keys, including two code-signing CAs.

Windows · Confirm disconnected and air-gapped Windows devices received the updated Disallowed CTL, redeploy disconnected Azure VMs from updated images, and inventory internal certificates chaining to eMudhra roots.

item.description:

Windows · Install it in the pilot ring only, watch for the Secure Boot certificate restart, and check who can trigger Cloud rebuild before the fixes reach everyone in November.

item.description:
